version_strings.string: Version=1.0.0-5731 (build 5731 matches manifest; Vendor=Alphanetworks, OEM=D-Link, OEMVersion=1.06)
Model=DCS-2102, ModelW=DCS-2121, ProdNameW=Wireless Megapixel Internet Camera (DCS-2102 wired / DCS-2121 wireless share one firmware)
tag version "$OEMVersion_ss" (web UI reads version at runtime from tinydb)

notes: ZIP contains firmware DCS-2121_fw_1-06_5731.bin (self-extracting POSIX sh script, Alphanetworks format) + Changes.txt (excluded as doc).

Update script: payload = tail -n +152 (md5 92a75058e8522c681924beeef6a01eee verified). Payload layout: ARM zImage kernel @0x5260 (1MB region, gzip@0x7E40), CramFS rootfs @0x105260 size 0x5A8000 (1255 entries), Proboot autoboot.bat trailer @~0x700000.

Rootfs filesystem is CramFS (little endian, zlib) — NOT squashfs; cramfsck not installed; extracted with 7z 23.01 (native CramFS support). 7z refused 126 'dangerous' symlinks (absolute /tmp/* targets and ../ relative targets e.g. usr/bin/*->../../bin/busybox); recreated all 126 from 7z error output -> 606 files + 585 symlinks + 63 dirs = 1254 entries (cramfs header counts 1255 incl. root).
OEM is Alphanetworks (not Vivotek like DCS-5615): ARM9 32-bit LSB, uClibc, linux-2.4.19 strings in kernel, busybox/lighttpd/smbmount/pppd largest ELFs.
Boot flash layout (autoboot.bat): kernel@0x60000 (1MB, load 0x220000), cramfs rootfs@0x160000 (0x2a0000), log@0x50000, tinydb@0x20000 (/dev/norchar1), pibinfo@0x0.

Config DB = Alpha tinydb: etc/db/dbinput.db (factory defaults incl. [HTTPAccount] _AdminUser=admin, [RTPServer] Port/Authenticate/Url1=play1.sdp ... Url4=3gpp) + etc/db/umconfig.txt (users table: admin/group 9_admin, guest/0_guest with hash-like passwords) — relevant for CVE-2013-1602/1603 (RTSP auth bypass / hardcoded creds).

Web stack: lighttpd (mod_cgi/mod_auth) + /var/www (xsl-based UI, var/www/cgi) + etc/rc.d/init.d/lighttpd.sh generates /tmp/lighttpd-inc.conf at runtime; etc/passwd,etc/shadow -> /tmp symlinks (runtime state).
etc/rtpd.conf + etc/rtspd.conf present (RTSP daemons, config mostly runtime).
